DML.SELECT: SELECT i.id as "id", i.incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", i.location_id as "locationId", i.user_id as "userId", i.road_impact_id as "roadImpactId", i.delayed_incident_state_type_id as "delayedIncidentStateTypeId", i.cron_expression as "cronExpression", i.enabled as "enabled", i.visible as "visible", i.created_at as "createdAt", i.last_update as "lastUpdate" FROM rt.ims_delayed_incident_reports i WHERE i.enabled = true or i.enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_delayed_incident_reports (id, incident_type_id, location_id, user_id, road_impact_id, cron_expression, enabled, visible, created_at, last_update) VALUES (:id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_delayed_incident_report_id'}, :incidentTypeId, :locationId, :userId, :roadImpactId, :cronExpression, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
